obligations.description: The LCD source divider first produces an internal rising edge on source cycle 1, then on cycle 25002, and then every 50001 cycles. After reset, alternating between high-EN action and low-EN hold, it sends eight initialization commands 38/38/38/38/08/01/06/0C, followed by HOME=80, 16 first-line characters, LINE2=C0, and 16 second-line characters, and repeats. RS is 0 for commands and 1 for characters. Each line is padded with spaces to 16 ASCII bytes: idle has ENTER PASSWORD on the first line and a blank second line; unlock has DOOR UNLOCKED on the first line and AUTO Lock Soon.. on the second line; wrong has WRONG PASSWORD! on the first line and Try Again on the second line; timeout has TIMEOUT ERROR on the first line and Start Again on the second line; all password-change stages have CHANGE PASSWORD on the first line and Enter New Code on the second line; blocked has four spaces followed by BLOCKED on the first line and a blank second line. idle displays timeout when the idle count reaches 4, as do incomplete ordinary password-entry stages. Each character uses the state at the time it is sent; whole-frame atomicity is not guaranteed.
